issues.description: Extraction always requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo's data/stories directory is empty, so the documented tiny pipeline cannot regenerate.
The end-to-end test fails immediately because it depends on missing story data rather than creating or mocking required inputs.
Packaging only includes emovec modules, not config.yaml or story/demo resources, so installed CLI defaults are not self-contained.
CLI defaults use repo-relative paths, which break when the console script is run outside the repository root.
Validation does not check manifest/backend/vector compatibility before using saved vectors with the configured backend.
If no configured emotions have built-in scenarios, validation crashes with a raw np.stack ValueError instead of a clear configuration error.
Single-emotion or sparse scenario runs can produce empty off-diagonal means and NaN summaries without being rejected.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 is accepted but still returns one component instead of projecting out zero components.
HF steering falls back to steering every token when offsets are unavailable or matching fails, corrupting the intended activity-token-only intervention.
Preference scoring assumes the first token of ' good' and ' bad' is a valid complete label token, which is tokenizer-dependent and can score the wrong token.
The HF backend loads the full model before moving it to the target device and lacks device_map or low-memory loading controls, making the documented Gemma run likely to OOM.
Missing scale configuration silently becomes empty emotions/topics/story counts, leading to later cryptic failures instead of upfront validation.
Committed demo artifacts reference source story metadata that is not present in the repository, masking that the pipeline is no longer reproducible.
